recommendation: Keep this audit as-is for core. Do not reintroduce or edit the retired Observation genetics CIGAR extension in current FHIR source; any legacy CIGAR guidance belongs in historical publication context or external genomics guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-7199 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics correction against the DSTU1 Observation genetics profile, related section 4.20.21.2. It said the profile's CIGAR definition did not agree with the external SAM definition example and the final resolution was to fix it by referring to an external definition.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-7199. Historical source shows the same old Observation genetics CIGAR definition was changed in commit a5c7c1d3520d1416f5c3356f71202601f3750063, which added external-definition wording: "Extended CIGAR string for aligning the sequence with reference bases" with a link to detailed CIGAR documentation. The same historical CIGAR family was later audited for FHIR-8037 and FHIR-8085 on the combined branch.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini still lists Observation as an active resource, but the old Observation genetics profile and geneticsCIGAR extension are no longer active core build inputs. Commit 3cfe12f1b4037e4fe922af288ba96fa49faf1435 removed outdated clinical genomics artifacts under source/observation, including the old Observation genetics spreadsheets and examples. Current core source and the FHIR Extension Pack have no geneticsCIGAR source to update; the extension pack only retains other retired/deprecated Observation genetics extensions that point users to the Genomics Reporting Guide. A later R5 change, FHIR-37414 in commit 9005b714065f69130872740b475cb3133c835057, removed the separate MolecularSequence cigar element as well.
reconciliation: Created an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The requested external-definition correction was historically applied to the retired Observation genetics CIGAR source, and there is no current FHIR core source location where another CIGAR wording edit would affect the build.
